description: Changes the landing zone's own automation makes, so they aren't reported as drift (docs/drift-spec.md sections 3.2 and 3.6). Placeholders in angle brackets are resolved from the operator's private drift-values.json. A rule hides nothing until its exact digest is approved in the private drift-approvals.json. Every field a rule gives must match; 'properties' must cover every changed property that runtime-paths.json leaves.

rules.why: The auto shutdown runbook drains session hosts before it stops them (avd-landing-zone decision 0011).
Locking sets the avdlz-power-lock tag and turns Start VM on Connect off; unlocking reverses both (decision 0011).
Locking tags the hosts with the scaling plan's exclusion tag so autoscale doesn't start them again (decision 0011).
The scaling plan drains hosts through the Azure Virtual Desktop service's own identity before it stops them.
A known policy assignment's remediation identity writes the settings that policy deploys.
